name: Lower Extremity Functional Scale
description: 20-item self-report of functional ability in lower extremity conditions. Higher score = better function.
copyright: Free for clinical/research use with attribution
shirleySays: ICC 0.94. MDC: 9 pts. MCID: 9 pts. Cronbach α 0.96. Validated in LBP, hip/knee OA, TKA/THA, ACL, ankle fracture, LE amputation. Quick to administer (~2 min).
